title: REPLACE: The Walk to the Market
style_block: warm hand-painted illustration, soft film grain, golden-hour palette, gentle light, no text
character_sheet: an elderly woman with silver braids, white cotton shawl with a thin green border, deep kind eyes, small blue bead necklace

music.caption: warm, gentle, sparse acoustic guitar and soft strings, pentatonic feel, calm, instrumental, no strong lead melody

shots.reason: Establishing shot: shows where and when the story happens.
shots.image_prompt: wide view of a hillside town at dawn, dirt road, mist, centred
shots.subtitle_en: Before sunrise, the town was still asleep.

shots.reason: Introduces the main character in a medium shot.
shots.image_prompt: the woman standing at her doorway holding a woven basket, centred
shots.motion_prompt: she slowly lifts the basket, camera static
shots.subtitle_en: Every morning my grandmother lifted her basket.

shots.reason: Close-up of hands carries the emotion: her work fed the family.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of weathered hands tying a cloth bundle, centred
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, fingers tighten the knot
shots.subtitle_en: Her hands fed all of us.

shots.reason: The journey: wide shot shows the distance she walked.
shots.image_prompt: the woman walking a long dirt road toward distant hills, small in frame, centred
shots.subtitle_en: She walked for two hours each way.

shots.reason: The market: sensory detail that makes the place real.
shots.image_prompt: busy colourful market stall with spices and baskets, woman bargaining, centred
shots.subtitle_en: At the market she knew everyone by name.

shots.reason: Insert shot of an object that carries memory.
shots.image_prompt: a worn blue enamel cup on a wooden table, centred, soft window light
shots.subtitle_en: This cup is all that remains.

shots.reason: Turn of the story: why it matters to the audience today.
shots.image_prompt: close-up of the woman's smiling face in warm evening light, centred
shots.subtitle_en: She taught us that work is a form of love.

shots.reason: Closing image echoes the opening and gives the feeling of the ending.
shots.image_prompt: the woman walking home at sunset on the same road, small in frame, centred
shots.subtitle_en: And every evening, she walked home.
